items.problem: `duplicateActions` reads only the properties written on a child node in the layout scene or its base scene chain, not those of the scene the child instances. Reproduced: a layout with children `A` and `B` that both instance `btn.tscn`, whose root `VirtualButton` has `action = &"jump"`, gives no finding, although skills/client-core/modules/virtual-pad-core.md says static check `virtual pad layout` blocks repeated actions in one layout. The same layout with `action = &"jump"` written on both children is reported. The code that reads the properties did not change in the range

The text counts as references files outside DEV code and regression tests, but `tools/src/commands/check/static/dev-reference.ts:16` and `:25` also skip all of `client/core/` and `server/core/`. Reproduced: `client/core/ui_core/ui_x.gd` holding `var a: DevTool` and `"res://dev/tool.gd"`, and `server/core/foo/index.ts` importing `./dev/x.js`, give no finding, while the same references in `client/features/` and `server/features/` do. The code comment says `core diff` covers core files, and skills/client-core/engines/godot.md:531 allows core a DEV entry path that the text as written would report, so the text is what needs correcting.
